title: Qiushi Fellow and Postdoctoral Researcher Positions (2027)
institution: Zhejiang University, Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics
about: Zhejiang University's Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics offers Qiushi Fellow and Postdoctoral Researcher positions in pure mathematics, starting 1 September 2027 by default. Applications, with three recommendation letters, are due mid-December 2026 on MathJobs.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Postdoctoral / early-career researchers" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Qiushi Fellow and Postdoctoral Researcher Positions" (research role) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
